question.text: Compound A gives D-Galactose and D-Glucose on hydrolysis. The compound A is :

solution.text: Lactose : It is a disaccharide of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>D</mi></math> -Galactose and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi><mo>-</mo></math> Glucose with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math> of galactose and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></math> of glucose link.
